commands.name: start
commands.help_text: Start a new pipeline with the provided context file.

params.name: context_file
params.help: Path to the context file for the pipeline

commands.name: status
commands.help_text: Show detailed progress of the specified pipeline.

commands.name: resume
commands.help_text:
Resume an interrupted pipeline from its last checkpoint.

    Use --node to restart from a specific node instead of resuming.
    Use --force to resume a running pipeline.

params.name: node_id
params.help: Restart from a specific node (instead of resuming from last checkpoint)

params.name: force
params.help: Force resume even if pipeline is running

commands.name: export
commands.help_text: Export all deliverables to the specified output directory.

params.name: output_path
params.help: Custom destination directory for exported files

params.name: include_metadata
params.help: Include _metadata.json in the export

commands.name: list-pipelines
commands.help_text: Show all pipelines with their status, optionally filtered by status.

params.name: status_filter
params.help: Filter pipelines by status

commands.name: questions
commands.help_text:
List all unanswered questions for the specified pipeline.

    Displays questions sorted by priority: blocking (red), clarifying (yellow), optional (dimmed).

    Use --run to query questions from a specific run instead of the latest.

params.name: run_id
params.help: Query a specific run ID instead of latest

commands.name: answer
commands.help_text:
Record an answer to a question.

    QUESTION_ID: The unique question ID (format: pipeline_id_node_index)

    ANSWER: The answer text, or use --text / -t option

params.name: text
params.help: Answer text (alternative to positional argument)

commands.name: cancel
commands.help_text:
Cancel a running pipeline.

    This will stop the pipeline execution and mark it as cancelled.

commands.name: cancel-all
commands.help_text:
Cancel all pipelines (or filter by status).

    Examples:
        # Cancel all pending pipelines
        python -m autoBMAD.docuswarm cancel-all --status pending --confirm

        # Cancel all pipelines with confirmation
        python -m autoBMAD.docuswarm cancel-all

params.name: status
params.help: Only cancel pipelines with this status

params.name: confirm
params.help: Skip confirmation prompt

commands.name: clean
commands.help_text:
Delete pipelines from database.

    WARNING: This permanently deletes pipeline data!

    Examples:
        # Delete all cancelled and failed pipelines
        python -m autoBMAD.docuswarm clean --status cancelled --confirm

        # Delete completed pipelines older than 7 days
        python -m autoBMAD.docuswarm clean --status completed --older-than-days 7

params.name: status
params.help: Only delete pipelines with this status

params.name: older_than_days
params.help: Only delete pipelines older than N days

params.name: confirm
params.help: Skip confirmation prompt

migration_gaps.description: 生产入口 (pyproject.toml) 仍指向旧 main 模块
migration_gaps.recommendation: 修改 pyproject.toml [project.scripts] 指向新入口

migration_gaps.description: 新入口缺失 2 个命令
migration_gaps.recommendation: 将缺失的命令实现迁移到 cli/commands/ 目录

migration_gaps.description: 服务层缺失 2 个预期方法
migration_gaps.recommendation: 在 PipelineService 中实现缺失的方法

migration_gaps.description: 旧入口有 3 个命令直接调用 asyncio.run
migration_gaps.recommendation: 将业务逻辑迁移到服务层，CLI 层只负责参数解析和结果展示

migration_gaps.description: 旧入口代码量过大，新入口过于精简
migration_gaps.recommendation: 这是正常的分层结果，新入口的代码量转移到 commands/ 和 services/ 目录

recommendations.title: 立即切换入口配置
recommendations.description: 修改 pyproject.toml 和 __main__.py 指向新入口
steps: 修改 __main__.py: from autoBMAD.docuswarm.cli.main import cli
验证 pip install -e . 后 docuswarm 命令可用
risks: 需要确保新入口的所有命令已实现

recommendations.title: 完成命令迁移
recommendations.description: 将 2 个命令从旧入口迁移到新入口
steps: 在 cli/commands/ 下创建新的命令模块
使用 PipelineService 封装业务逻辑
保持命令行接口向后兼容
risks: 命令参数可能有细微差异，需要验证

recommendations.title: 删除或归档旧入口
recommendations.description: 在验证新入口稳定后删除旧 main.py
steps: 确保所有旧命令在新入口可用
risks: 如果有其他模块直接导入旧 main.py 会失败
